name: Overclocked Electromancer — "double its power" in a self trigger doubles the source
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py (theme: double its power). 'Whenever this creature attacks, double its power until end of turn.' fired to nothing: the doubling parser only knew "double X's power" and "double the power of X", and "its" has no apostrophe. _addAbilityPseudo now rewrites 'double its power' to the creature the trigger condition names. A self trigger pins to the source: the 2/2 becomes 4/2, the Bears are untouched.

call: double its power until end of turn.
Whenever this creature attacks, double its power until end of turn.
